fullDescription: Friendly illustrated split-screen signup for an AI design-canvas product ('Bloomly'): a soft sky-blue ground with one big white rounded card split into a left rich sky-gradient illustration panel (a tilted miniature design-canvas card with a tiny prompt bar, floating reaction/stat chips and an overlapping avatar stack) and a right create-account form, with a sky+coral accent system, chunky Nunito type, a password strength meter, a gradient CTA, Google/GitHub social auth, a sticky translucent nav and a logo trust strip.

structured.summary: A warm, illustrated split-screen signup for a friendly AI design-canvas product ('Bloomly'). The page is a soft sky-blue ground with a single big white rounded card split in two: on the left, a deep sky-gradient illustration panel with a tilted miniature 'design canvas' card (a tiny prompt bar feeding a magic-wand mockup), floating reaction/stat chips, an overlapping avatar stack and a friendly closing line; on the right, the create-account form (first/last name row, email with a live valid check, password with a show toggle and a 4-segment strength meter, a pre-checked terms checkbox, a big gradient CTA, a Google/GitHub social-auth row and an encryption reassurance line). A sticky translucent nav with a lotus-gradient logo sits on top, and a logo trust strip closes the page. The mood is playful, rounded and reassuring: chunky Nunito type, sky + coral accents, soft blobs and gentle floating motion.

style.description: Friendly, rounded, illustrated SaaS aesthetic on a soft sky ground (#f4f9ff) with slate text (#1e293b). The accent system is a sky brand blue #38bdf8 paired with a coral/rose #fb7185; the primary CTA is a deeper sky gradient (135deg #0369a1 -> #075985) and the illustration panel is a rich sky gradient (br #0ea5e9 -> #0284c7 -> #075985) with a contrast scrim so white copy clears 4.5:1. Type is Nunito (weights 400-900); headings are font-900 with tight tracking (the form H1 ~34-38px, leading ~1.1), labels are font-800, body is font-600. Everything is heavily rounded: a 2.5rem (rounded-5xl) outer card, 2rem (rounded-4xl) illustration panel, rounded-2xl inputs/buttons, rounded-full pills/avatars. Depth is soft and colored: a big sky-tinted card shadow (0 40px 90px -30px rgba(56,189,248,.4)) with a sky-100 ring, a deep sky CTA shadow (0 14px 30px -10px rgba(3,105,161,.55) lifting on hover), and white floating chips with xl shadows. Texture/motion: three blurred sky/coral background blobs and a faint radial dot grid on the panel, with gentle 'floaty' translate-y keyframe animation on the blobs, chips, canvas card and stars. Inputs are slate-50 with a 2px slate-200 border that turns sky on focus (4px sky/18 ring + white fill). Icons are Iconify Phosphor (plus brand logos). Mood: warm, playful, human, soft and trustworthy.
style.prompt: Design a friendly, illustrated split-screen signup page. Ground the page in a soft sky-blue #f4f9ff with slate #1e293b text, and use a two-color accent system: a bright sky brand blue #38bdf8 and a coral/rose #fb7185. Put everything inside one big white card with a very large radius (2.5rem) carrying a soft SKY-TINTED shadow (0 40px 90px -30px rgba(56,189,248,.4)) and a 1px sky-100 ring, split into two equal columns on desktop and stacking on mobile. The LEFT column is an illustration panel: a 2rem-radius box filled with a rich sky gradient (135deg #0ea5e9 -> #0284c7 -> #075985), a faint white radial dot grid at ~18% opacity, and a top+bottom dark scrim (rgba(3,55,86,.55) -> transparent -> rgba(3,55,86,.62)) so white text stays legible; float small white dots and a tilted miniature 'design canvas' card plus reaction/stat chips and an avatar stack inside it. The RIGHT column is the form on white. Typography is Nunito, weights 400-900: headings are font-900 with tight tracking (form H1 ~34-38px, line-height ~1.1), labels font-800, body font-600. Round everything heavily: rounded-2xl inputs and buttons, rounded-full pills and avatars. Inputs are slate-50 fills with a 2px slate-200 border that on focus turns sky #38bdf8 with a 4px rgba(56,189,248,.18) ring and a white fill. The primary CTA is a deeper-sky gradient pill (135deg #0369a1 -> #075985) in white font-900 text with a deep sky shadow (0 14px 30px -10px rgba(3,105,161,.55)) that lifts up 2px and deepens on hover. Background extras: three large blurred blobs (sky-200/45, coral/20, sky-100/60) and gentle 'floaty' up-down keyframe motion (translateY ~-12px, 5-7.5s loops) on the blobs, chips, the canvas card and the stars. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:flower-lotus-fill, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:envelope-simple, ph:lock-simple, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:gift-fill, ph:shield-check-fill, ph:figma/framer-logo-fill) plus the Google and GitHub brand logos. Mood: playful, rounded, warm, reassuring, soft and human, never corporate.

layout_and_structure.description: A one-screen signup: a slim sticky translucent nav on top, a hero/signup main holding a single big white card split into a left illustration panel and a right form column, and a logo trust strip footer. On desktop the card is a 2-column grid (lg:grid-cols-2); on mobile it stacks (illustration above form). The background carries soft floating blobs behind everything. The defining structural moves are the split illustrated-panel + form card, the tilted miniature 'design canvas' illustration with floating chips and an avatar stack, and the rich-gradient panel with a contrast scrim.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header, z-50, with a translucent sky background (#f4f9ff at 85%) and a strong backdrop blur, plus a 1px bottom border in sky-100/70. Inner row max-w-7xl, 72px tall, space-between, ~24-32px side padding. Left: the logo = a 40px rounded-2xl tile filled with a sky->coral gradient (br #38bdf8 -> #fb7185) holding a white ph:flower-lotus-fill icon, beside a 22px font-900 tight-tracked 'Bloomly' wordmark. Center (md+ only): four nav links 'Templates', 'Canvas', 'Pricing', 'Showcase' in 15px font-700 slate-600, each with an animated coral underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover. Right: a 'Log in' text link (slate-700, sm+ only, hovering to sky-600) and a 'Get started' button = a slate-900 rounded-full pill with white 15px font-800 text and a soft shadow that lightens to slate-800 on hover.

The signup <main> is relative and overflow-hidden. Behind everything, pointer-events-none and -z-10, place three large blurred circular blobs that float gently: a 24rem sky-200/45 blob off the top-left, a 26rem coral-brand/20 blob off the top-right, and a 20rem sky-100/60 blob at the bottom-center-left. Give them a subtle blur and a slow 'floaty' translate-y keyframe (translateY 0 -> -12px -> 0 over 5-7.5s, staggered).

Center a max-w-7xl container with ~40-64px vertical padding. Inside, one big white card: rounded-5xl (2.5rem), a soft sky-tinted shadow (0 40px 90px -30px rgba(56,189,248,.4)), a 1px sky-100 ring, overflow-hidden, with ~16-20px inner padding. Lay it out as a single column on mobile and a 2-column grid (lg:grid-cols-2) with ~32-40px gap on desktop, the two columns stretched to equal height (items-stretch). Left cell = the illustration panel, right cell = the form.

A rounded-4xl (2rem) panel, min-height ~420px mobile / ~640px desktop, filled with a sky gradient (br #0ea5e9 -> #0284c7 -> #075985), ~32-48px padding, a vertical flex that pushes a brand line to the top, the illustration to the middle and a copy block to the bottom. Layer behind the content: a faint white radial dot grid (radial-gradient #fff 1.5px dots on a 26px cell) at ~18% opacity, and a top+bottom contrast scrim (linear-gradient rgba(3,55,86,.55) at 0% -> transparent 28-58% -> rgba(3,55,86,.62) at 100%) so white text clears 4.5:1. Scatter three small floating white dots (80/60/70% opacity) with the floaty animation. TOP: a brand line = a 36px rounded-xl white/20 backdrop-blur tile with a white ph:flower-lotus-fill icon beside an 18px font-800 white 'Bloomly Canvas'. BOTTOM: a copy block in white = a 2xl/3xl font-900 headline 'Design at the speed
of a good idea.' and a font-600 sub line 'Prompt it, tweak it, ship it. Your friendliest AI design canvas is waiting.'

In the middle of the illustration panel, a relative ~56-64 wide group, centered. The hero object is a tilted (rotate -4deg) white rounded-3xl card with a deep sky shadow and ~20px padding (the floaty animation), representing a design canvas: a row of three traffic-light dots (coral, amber-300, emerald-300), a 80px tall preview tile with a sky-100 -> coral/30 gradient holding a big sky ph:magic-wand-fill icon, then a tiny 'prompt bar' (a slate-100 rounded-xl pill with a small coral ph:sparkle-fill, a flexible slate-200 progress line, and a 16px sky-500 rounded send button with a white ph:arrow-up-bold), and two skeleton text lines (slate-200, slate-100). Around it, floating (each with its own floaty loop and slight rotation): a white rounded-2xl 'Loved it!' chip (rotate 6deg) = a coral/15 tile with a coral ph:heart-fill + bold slate text; a white rounded-2xl '2,000+ prompts' chip (rotate -6deg) = a sky-100 tile with a sky ph:sparkle-fill + bold slate text; and a white rounded-full avatar chip below = an overlapping (-space-x-2.5) stack of three 28px ring-2 ring-white gradient avatars (sky 'A', coral->rose 'J', amber->orange 'M') beside a bold slate-500 '+12k'.

The right column is a flex-col justify-center with ~16-48px side padding, holding a centered max-w-md form block. Top to bottom: (1) a free-plan pill = an inline-flex rounded-full white pill with a 1px coral/40 ring and a soft shadow, holding a small rose ph:gift-fill icon and 'Free forever plan' in 12px font-800 rose-700. (2) A headline 'Create your account' in ~34-38px font-900 tight-tracked slate-900, leading ~1.1. (3) A sub line in slate-600 font-600: 'Already with us?' followed by a 'Log in here' sky-700 font-800 link with a sky-300 2px underline.

A form (~28px top margin, ~20px vertical rhythm). (1) A 2-column name grid: 'First name' (placeholder 'Ada') and 'Last name' (placeholder 'Lovelace'), each a labelled (font-800 slate-700) rounded-2xl 2px-slate-200 slate-50 input, ~12-16px padding, 15px font-600, slate-500 placeholders. (2) 'Email address' = a rounded-2xl input with a leading slate-400 ph:envelope-simple icon and a trailing emerald-500 ph:check-circle-fill (live-valid indicator), placeholder 'ada@bloomly.dev'. (3) 'Password' = a rounded-2xl input with a leading ph:lock-simple icon and a trailing slate eye toggle button (ph:eye), placeholder 'At least 8 characters', followed by a 4-segment strength meter (four flex-1 rounded-full bars: two sky-brand filled, one coral-brand/40, one slate-200) and a small font-800 'Good' label. All inputs share the focus treatment: border turns sky #38bdf8 with a 4px rgba(56,189,248,.18) ring and a white fill. (4) A terms checkbox row = a custom pre-checked checkbox (a 20px rounded-md border-2 slate-300 box that becomes sky-600 fill with a white ph:check-bold when checked) beside a font-600 slate-600 'I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.' with rose-700 underlined links. (5) The submit CTA = a full-width rounded-2xl gradient button (135deg #0369a1 -> #075985) in white 16px font-900 'Create my account' with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold, a deep sky shadow, lifting 2px on hover.

Below the form: (1) an 'or sign up with' divider = a centered 12px font-800 slate-500 label between two slate-200 hairlines. (2) A 2-column social row of two buttons: a 'Google' button (logos:google-icon) and a 'GitHub' button (ph:github-logo-fill), each a rounded-2xl 2px-slate-200 white pill in 15px font-800 slate-700 that on hover gets a sky-100 border, a sky-50 fill and lifts 1px. (3) A centered reassurance line: a slate-500 ph:shield-check-fill icon beside 'Secured with end-to-end encryption' in 12px font-700 slate-600.

A full-width section with a 1px top border in sky-100 on a white/60 fill. Inner max-w-7xl row, ~28px vertical padding, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+. Left: a 14px font-700 slate-600 line 'Trusted by designers at fast-moving teams everywhere'. Right: a row of four 2xl slate-500 Phosphor logo glyphs (ph:figma-logo-fill, ph:framer-logo-fill, ph:pen-nib-fill, ph:palette-fill) that darken to slate-700 on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: Split illustrated-panel + form card: one big white rounded-5xl card (soft sky-tinted shadow + sky-100 ring) split into a left rich-gradient illustration panel (rounded-4xl, br #0ea5e9 -> #075985) and a right white form column, a 2-col grid on desktop that stacks on mobile.

Tilted miniature 'design canvas' illustration: a rotate(-4deg) white rounded-3xl card showing traffic-light dots, a magic-wand preview tile, a tiny 'prompt bar' (coral sparkle + progress line + a sky send button) and skeleton lines, gently floating.

Floating reaction/stat chips + avatar stack: white rounded chips ('Loved it!' with a coral heart, '2,000+ prompts' with a sky sparkle, each slightly rotated) and an overlapping -space-x-2.5 stack of three gradient initial avatars with a bold '+12k' count, all on their own floaty loops.

Password strength meter: a 4-segment row of flex-1 rounded-full bars (two sky-brand filled, one coral/40, one slate-200) with a font-800 'Good' label, beneath a password input with a leading lock icon and a trailing eye toggle.

Focus-reactive rounded inputs: slate-50 fills with a 2px slate-200 border that on focus turns sky #38bdf8 with a 4px rgba(56,189,248,.18) ring and a white fill; the email field carries a live emerald check-circle valid indicator.
Gradient primary CTA: a full-width rounded-2xl deeper-sky gradient pill (135deg #0369a1 -> #075985) with white font-900 text + a trailing arrow and a deep sky drop-shadow that lifts on hover.

Soft floating blob background + dot-grid panel: three large blurred sky/coral blobs behind the page and a faint white radial dot grid over the gradient panel, all with gentle 'floaty' translate-y motion, plus a top/bottom contrast scrim keeping white copy at 4.5:1.
Custom pre-checked terms checkbox: a 20px rounded-md slate-300 box that fills sky-600 with a white check-bold when checked, beside a terms/privacy line with rose-700 underlined links.

structured.special_notes: Keep the two-color friendly system: a soft sky #f4f9ff ground with slate #1e293b text, a sky brand blue #38bdf8 and a coral/rose #fb7185 as the only accents; the primary CTA and the illustration panel use the deeper sky gradients (#0369a1 -> #075985 for the button, #0ea5e9 -> #0284c7 -> #075985 for the panel). Use Nunito throughout (weights 400-900): headings are font-900 and tight-tracked (the form H1 ~34-38px, leading ~1.1), labels font-800, body font-600. Round everything heavily: a 2.5rem outer card, a 2rem illustration panel, rounded-2xl inputs/buttons, rounded-full pills/avatars. Depth is soft and colored: the big sky-tinted card shadow + sky-100 ring, the deep sky CTA shadow, white xl-shadow floating chips. The signature is the SPLIT signup card, a left illustrated gradient panel (a tilted miniature 'design canvas' card with a tiny prompt bar feeding a magic-wand mockup, floating 'Loved it!' / '2,000+ prompts' chips and an overlapping avatar stack with a '+12k' count) beside a right create-account form (first/last name row, an email with a live emerald valid-check, a password with a show toggle + a 4-segment strength meter, a pre-checked terms checkbox, the gradient CTA, a Google/GitHub social row and an encryption reassurance line). On the gradient panel, always layer a top+bottom dark scrim under white copy so it clears 4.5:1, plus the faint white radial dot grid. Inputs are slate-50 with a 2px slate-200 border that turns sky on focus (4px sky/18 ring + white fill). Add gentle motion: three blurred background blobs and the canvas card/chips/avatars/stars float on slow 'floaty' translate-y loops. Top it with a sticky translucent (#f4f9ff/85 + backdrop-blur) nav (a sky->coral lotus-gradient logo tile, four coral-underline nav links, a 'Log in' link + a slate-900 rounded-full 'Get started' pill) and close with a logo trust strip (Figma/Framer/pen-nib/palette Phosphor glyphs). Everything must reflow cleanly: the card stacks (illustration above form) below lg, the name grid and social row stay 2-col, the nav center links hide below md and 'Log in' below sm, the trust strip stacks, no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, playful and human with zero em-dashes.
